description: With the phone set to Japanese and uiLanguage = System: phone UI fully Japanese, switching to English and back re-renders phone and glasses immediately, dates/durations formatted correctly, G2 menu and captions status readable and untruncated, consent screens correct, export in the UI language. Repeat with phone in English and uiLanguage = 日本語. Screenshots in a comment here.
title: On-device verification: Japanese UI on Android/iOS and the G2
